description: Self-update + first-run notification permission, scoped to the trusted first-party windows that actually use them: 'popover' (startup update check → download → relaunch, via updater.ts), 'settings' (manual update check), 'onboarding' (notification permission prompt). Deliberately EXCLUDES 'overlay-*': the takeover alert renders untrusted calendar text and has no business holding process-relaunch/updater reach.
